verdict.rationale: LibreOffice documents batch headless conversion via --convert-to, with export filters for open formats such as PDF, EPUB, SVG and Parquet. A community user also reports running it in Docker to generate PDFs and normalize document formats. That covers the core of exporting data in open formats, but the pack does not document a complete, account-level 'export everything and leave' path. missing for 10: explicit evidence of native ODF/OpenDocument export, documentation that all data types (including settings, macros and Base databases) can be exported losslessly, and independent corroboration of round-trip fidelity in open formats.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
